method.independent_unit: fresh JVM fork; within-fork pairs are correlated
method.order: AB/BA alternates by pair and fork; A=frozen baseline B=current
method.quantiles: nearest-rank; median is arithmetic middle for even n
method.ratio: paired old/new; >1 means current faster; no ratio for idle control
method.order_sensitivity: descriptive AB vs BA pair ratios; pairs within a fork are correlated
method.timer_control: scene 17 retains empty call-loop timer ns; compare magnitude, never subtract or call it solver cost
method.diagnostics: existing published outputs read outside API timing; checksumNs includes these diagnostic reads
method.timed_region: API includes sync/read, physics, world queries, publication/write; excludes input updates, seed reads, checksums, prepare/release. No core decomposition. No timer subtraction.
limits: synthetic Kahlua/world fixtures, not actual game frame/FPS
warmup configured, not proof of JIT steady state; inspect longer runs
checksum walks excluded but influence cache/GC between ticks
4x32 are four independent valid 32-body groups, not a 128-body solver group
bridge costs are separate static-fixture diagnostics, not additive API decomposition; counters disabled
group timings sum calls within one synthetic tick; no scheduling/Lua bridge overhead
checksums compare old/new within each API, not stale persistent history against solve

bridge_method: Separate initialized clone fixtures, after all primary measurements; repeated Body.read(mode) and Body.write(mode) only, no physics, no group publication, no input advancement. Not an additive API decomposition; never subtract.
